Name: JP's Utility Machines - Quality Enricher - Aged Everything
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ffff][size=6][u][center]Ethereal Enricher[/center][/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]Because wanting a piece of Iridium quality wood is not a whim, it is a basic human need!
[/i][/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]5 Casks with unique capabilities will be available for purchase in Robin's store, [b][i][color=#00ff00]you will be able to buy their recipes[/color][/i][/b]. All require 50 pieces of wood and 5 Hardwood. Each of the Casks can age and increase the quality of 1 of 5 kinds of items in the game. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The procedure is manual, which means that you must remove and replace the objects inside the Casks to continue aging, at least you can place them in any interior! They do not work outdoors.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Certain objects are forbidden to be placed in these Casks for obvious reasons, nor will they replace the functions of the Casks inside the cellar.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[list]
[*][size=4]A rotten Cask in case you want to reduce the quality of an object, who knows, you might need it![/size]
[/list][/size]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]That's the most important thing, you will be able to discover the potential of this mod, I hope you enjoy it![/i][/size][/color]

[b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6]You can make and publish your translations without asking for permission![/size][/color][/i][/b]
